correctness.rationale: TARGET is a universal vanishing claim over even m>=6; a single certified positive value on the ray falsifies it. Shape/boundary checks pass: |A6|=9+7+5+3=24, |B6|=8+7+5+4=24, |C6|=7+6+6+5=24; each has 4 rows; distinct part counts 4,4,3 meet the stated deep-cell condition. Code review: Murnaghan-Nakayama via sub-partition rim-hook enumeration (no-2x2, edge-connectivity, sign (-1)^(rows-1)), recursion on class parts, z(mu)=prod i^{m_i} m_i!, exact Fraction class sum — arithmetically sound, stdlib-only, no rounding. Auditor independently re-executed in this environment: --selftest OK (g((3,2,1)^3)=5, g((2,1)^3)=1, three n=6 norms=1); direct g(A6,B6,C6)=134682 with 671 nonzero-term classes; all 6 char orthonormality inner products at n=24 (<A,A>=<B,B>=<C,C>=1, cross=0); hook-length dims (7228208988, 5205500300, 1262068236) equal chi at identity class 1^24; reproduction of independently recorded maxima g((4,2,1,1)^3)=17 and g((5,3,2,1,1)^3)=945; committed cert_n24.csv (672 lines incl. header, 671 rows) sums exactly to 134682; all 6 S3 permutations give 134682; full-row recompute over all 1575 partitions of 24 gives every g(A,B,nu) a nonnegative integer and sum_nu g*dim(nu)=37626444055496696400=dA*dB exactly. The large positive value (134682>>0) is robust against any rounding concern since all arithmetic is exact. Route logic is valid: ordinary nonvanishing at m=6 kills (i) chamber-forced atomic zero (cannot hold where ordinary is large positive under the claimed transfer), (ii) universal ordinary vanishing, and (iii) any vanishing face built on the ray. Non-claims (other rays, odd m, atomic level) are honestly scoped.
